question: A project consists of the following 7 activities, with their durations (in days) as follows: $A(4), B(3), C(5), D(2), E(10), F(10), G(1)$. The following priorities are also given: $A \\rightarrow G, D ; E, G \\rightarrow F; D, F \\rightarrow C ; F \\rightarrow B$. The daily cost of work is 1000 euros; in addition, a special machinery must be rented from the start of activity $A$ to the end of activity $B$, with a daily cost of 5000 euros. Formulate this problem as a linear programming problem and solve it using COPTPY.

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Structured formulation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Decision variables
#   s[j]  : start time (days) of activity j, j in J          -> NonNegativeReals
#   f     : project finish time (days)                       -> NonNegativeReals
#   m     : machinery rental duration (days)                 -> NonNegativeReals
#
# Objective (minimise total cost, euros)
#   1000 * f  +  5000 * m
#   where 1000 = daily work cost, 5000 = daily machinery cost.
#
# Constraints
#   (1) Precedence: for each arc (i, j) in PREC,
#         s[j] >= s[i] + dur[i]
#       (source: the priority list A->G, A->D, E->G, G->F, D->C, F->C, F->B)
#   (2) Finish: for every activity j,
#         f >= s[j] + dur[j]
#       (project finishes when the last activity ends)
#   (3) Machinery: machinery is rented from the start of A to the end of B,
#         m >= (s[B] + dur[B]) - s[A]
#       (linear expression, no products of variables)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DATA = {
    "activities": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"],
    "duration": {
        "A": 4,
        "B": 3,
        "C": 5,
        "D": 2,
        "E": 10,
        "F": 10,
        "G": 1,
    },
    # precedence arcs (i, j) meaning i must finish before j starts
    "precedence": [
        ("A", "G"),
        ("A", "D"),
        ("E", "G"),
        ("G", "F"),
        ("D", "C"),
        ("F", "C"),
        ("F", "B"),
    ],
    "work_cost_per_day": 1000,
    "machinery_cost_per_day": 5000,
    "horizon": 1000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.J = pyo.Set(initialize=d["activities"])
    model.P = pyo.Set(dimen=2, initialize=d["precedence"])

    # Variables
    model.s = pyo.Var(
        model.J,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(0, d["horizon"]),
    )
    model.f = pyo.Var(
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(0, d["horizon"]),
    )
    model.m = pyo.Var(
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(0, d["horizon"]),
    )

    # (1) Precedence constraints
    def prec_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.s[j] >= m.s[i] + d["duration"][i]

    model.prec = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=prec_rule)

    # (2) Finish-time constraints
    def finish_rule(m, j):
        return m.f >= m.s[j] + d["duration"][j]

    model.finish = pyo.Constraint(model.J, rule=finish_rule)

    # (3) Machinery rental duration: from start of A to end of B
    def machinery_rule(m):
        return m.m >= (m.s["B"] + d["duration"]["B"]) - m.s["A"]

    model.machinery = pyo.Constraint(rule=machinery_rule)

    # Objective
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=d["work_cost_per_day"] * model.f
        + d["machinery_cost_per_day"] * model.m,
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    return model

    "rent_end": "B",          # ... to end of this activity
    "bigM": 100000,
}


def build_model(data=None):

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.activities = pyo.Set(initialize=d["activities"])
    model.prec = pyo.Set(initialize=[(u, v) for (u, v) in d["precedences"]],
                         dimen=2)

    # start day of each activity (NonNegativeReals, domain stated explicitly)
    model.start = pyo.Var(model.activities, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))
    # finish day of each activity

    # rental span of the machine, measured in days
    model.rent_days = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))

    def finish_rule(m, j):
        # finish must be at least start plus the fixed duration (activity-day count p_j)
        return m.finish[j] >= m.start[j] + d["dur"][j]
    model.finish_def = pyo.Constraint(model.activities, rule=finish_rule)

    def finish_bound_rule(m, j):
        # finish cannot exceed start plus longest horizon placeholders times value
        return m.finish[j] <= m.start[j] + d["dur"][j] + d["bigM"] * 0
    model.finish_ub = pyo.Constraint(model.activities, rule=finish_bound_rule)

    def prec_rule(m, u, v):
        # u must be completed before v can start
        return m.start[v] >= m.finish[u]
    model.precedence = pyo.Constraint(model.prec, rule=prec_rule)

    def rent_lower_end_rule(m):
        # machine is rented at least until the end of rent_end activity
        return m.rent_days >= m.finish[d["rent_end"]]
    model.rent_end = pyo.Constraint(rule=rent_lower_end_rule)

    model.rent_start = pyo.Constraint(rule=rent_lower_start_rule)

    model.anchor = pyo.Constraint(rule=anchor_rule)

    # total integer work cost: constant sums of p_j times c_work
    fixed_work = sum(d["dur"][j] for j in d["activities"]) * d["c_work"]

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=fixed_work + d["c_mach"] * model.rent_days,
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

    return model

        ),
        sense=pyo.minimize,
    )

}
# M big upper bound for the makespan of all activities
DATA["big_horizon"] = sum(DATA["duration"].values())  # 35

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    acts = d["activities"]
    dur = d["duration"]
    prec = d["precedence"]
    info = {i: j for j, i in enumerate(acts)}
    m.I = pyo.Set(initialize=acts, ordered=True, dimen=1)
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=[(info[a], info[b]) for a, b in prec],
                  ordered=True, dimen=2)

    horizon = d["big_horizon"]

    # decision: start day of each activity
    m.start = pyo.Var(m.I, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      bounds=(0, horizon))

    # decision: project makespan
    m.T = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, horizon))

    # start / end helpers of the machine-relevant activities
    m.machine_start = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, horizon))
    # (we do not need an explicit end var; use start[B] + dur[B])

    def duration_rule(m, a):
        return dur[a]
    m.act_dur = pyo.Param(m.I, initialize=duration_rule)

    # ---- objective: work-day cost on makespan + machinery-days cost --------
    def obj_rule(m):
        work = d["daily_work_cost"] * m.T
        # machinery spans from start of A to completion of B:
        # start of A = start[A]; completion of B = start[B] + dur[B]
        machine = d["machinery_cost"] * (
            m.start[d["machine_end_act"]] + dur[d["machine_end_act"]]
            - m.start[d["machine_start_act"]]
        )
        return work + machine
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---- one constraint per precedence relation --------------------------
    def prec_rule(m, j, k):
        a = acts[j]
        b = acts[k]
        return m.start[b] >= m.start[a] + dur[a]
    m.precedence_link = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=prec_rule)

    # ---- project completion must cover every activity ---------------------
    def makespan_rule(m, i):
        return m.T >= m.start[i] + dur[i]
    m.finish_tight = pyo.Constraint(m.I, rule=makespan_rule)

    return m
